newsitem.title: UK: UK's Carlton Communications buys Action Time.
newsitem.headline: UK's Carlton Communications buys Action Time.

text.p: British independent TV company Carlton Communications Plc said on Monday it bought Action Time, which produces or licences game shows and other entertainment programmes, for 3.45 million stg.
Carlton said it would pay 1.18 million stg through the issue of 240,571 ordinary shares, and the rest in cash.
Carlton may also pay up to 4.3 million stg in ordinary shares, subject to performance targets being met.
Action Time has strategic alliances with broadcasters and independent producers in 16 countries.
Chairman Stephen Leahy will continue to run the company, which will retain its separate identity within Carlton.
Carlton previously owned 15 percent of the company.
The news followed Carlton's 85 million stg acquisition of privately-owned Westcountry Television over the weekend.
